en: The postcard is split into two sepia-toned photographic views. The upper image shows an industrial or mining facility situated in a hilly, rural landscape. Several buildings and smokestacks suggest industrial activity, likely mining. The lower image depicts rows of identical, small white houses arranged on a hillside, indicative of worker housing or a planned settlement. In between the two images, text reads: 'Üdvözlet Komlóról'.
